name: app_launcher
description: Open a URL, file, or application using the system default handler.

target.description: URL, file path, or application name to open

manual.overview: Use to open URLs in the browser, launch apps, or open files with their default handlers—ideal for surfacing results or starting workflows.

examples.description: Open a documentation URL in the default browser
Open a local file with its default application
Launch an application by name (if in PATH)

tips: Use full URLs including https:// for web links
For files, use absolute paths to avoid resolution issues
The system chooses the handler; you cannot force a specific app
edge_cases: Malformed URLs or missing files may open an error or nothing
Some systems restrict opening arbitrary executables by name
